purpose: Machine-readable index of the backend services — what each does, its invariants, and the routes that call it.

CheckEngine.responsibility: The six-check gate; the single source of truth for whether a deal may book.
checks_in_order: COUNTERPARTY_APPROVED — status ACTIVE and permitted for this instrument
INSTRUMENT_PERMITTED — CounterpartyInstrument row exists and enabled
GROUP_LIMIT — sum across the credit group ≤ CpGroup.group_limit_pence
TENOR_BAND — tenor ≤ RatingBand.max_tenor_months for the counterparty's rating
CONCENTRATION — new share of portfolio ≤ policy.concentration_cap_bp

DealService.responsibility: Persist a deal after running the checks; write CheckRun + Deal in one transaction.
invariants: Nothing else in the code writes to the deal table.
Every write is paired with a CheckRun row for evidence.

PlannerService.responsibility: Propose up to three deployment plans for idle cash: Blended, Higher yield, Tighter concentration.

algorithm.blended: greedy yield-first fill inside the treasurer's band caps + per-name cap + group concentration cap
algorithm.higher_yield: widen A/BBB caps by +25pts and fill bands in order BBB → A → AA → AAA (yield-chasing shape)
algorithm.tighter_concentration: equal-share round-robin across ≥6 eligible names, still respecting caps

post_processing: run six checks on every allocation via CheckEngine
drop any allocation that would fail
dedup variants whose allocation set is identical to Blended
populate undeployed_pence so the modal can show the trade-off
PlannerService.writes: nothing (proposals only; the treasurer commits via the ticket)

planner_settings.key_decision: Buckets are CAPS not targets (ADR-0003). Any leftover cash stays uninvested if caps don't cover 100%.

HedgeService.responsibility: Link an FX forward Deal to a CurrencyExposure; enforce over-hedge invariant; recompute exposure status.
invariants: Only instrument = FX_FORWARD can cover a currency obligation.
Coverage cannot exceed the exposure amount (across all live links).
Status flows: IDENTIFIED → PARTIALLY_COVERED → COVERED → SETTLED (never backwards past SETTLED).

FxExposureService.responsibility: Read-side aggregation for the Hedging panel: summary per currency, bucketed drilldown, GBP equivalent.

FxRateService.responsibility: Mock spot + forward rates for EUR/GBP, USD/GBP, CHF/GBP.
FxRateService.forward_model: linear from annual forward points; deliberately simple for the prototype
FxRateService.safety: never returns a rate for a pair not in _PAIRS; ValueError otherwise

fx_narrator.responsibility: AI briefing + recommendations + watch callouts for the Hedging panel; plus per-hedge governance advisor for the Initiate modal.
safety_rails: counterparty_id whitelisted to eligible FX_FORWARD-permitted actives
amount whitelisted to _suggested_amount() choices per currency
monetary strings pre-formatted to '€10m'-style and echoed verbatim by LLM
deterministic fallback runs when no Groq key or LLM output fails validation

planner_narrator.responsibility: AI executive summary + per-candidate labels for the Deploy Idle Cash modal.

AdvisoryService.responsibility: The overnight run that ranks candidates and writes an advisory brief.

credit_signal_scanner.responsibility: Read seeded NewsItem rows, classify materiality, emit per-counterparty severity + suggested action.

ExposureCalculator.responsibility: Recompute counterparty and group exposure on every call — no caching.
ExposureCalculator.principle: A cached figure that drifts from the deals behind it is worse than a slow query.

measurement_discipline.counterparty_exposure: GBP pence, principal_pence + fx add-on for forwards
measurement_discipline.currency_exposure: minor units of the stated currency, with the currency on every row
measurement_discipline.never_join: counterparty_exposure and currency_exposure are never combined into a single number

background_jobs: AdvisoryService.run (overnight, produces the morning advisory brief) — no scheduler yet, manual trigger
